server start
skygo --json run default.yaml --request-id runtime-default --wait
job-id DEFAULT
skygo jobs logs $DEFAULT
stdout '^0/1/0\n$'
skygo --json run override.yaml --request-id runtime-override --wait
job-id OVERRIDE
skygo jobs logs $OVERRIDE
stdout '^0/7/0\n$'
server stop
! stderr .

-- default.yaml --
run: |
  printf '%s/%s/%s\n' "$SKYPILOT_NODE_RANK" "$SKYPILOT_NUM_NODES" "$SKYPILOT_NUM_GPUS_PER_NODE"
-- override.yaml --
envs:
  SKYPILOT_NODE_RANK: '99'
  SKYPILOT_NUM_NODES: '7'
  SKYPILOT_NUM_GPUS_PER_NODE: '99'
run: |
  printf '%s/%s/%s\n' "$SKYPILOT_NODE_RANK" "$SKYPILOT_NUM_NODES" "$SKYPILOT_NUM_GPUS_PER_NODE"
